records.rule: Everything inside cats2 (ed209l), including rebooting and deallocating it, is approved. Keys and the Auth, the Azure network security group, and every other node are not (Tom Dyer, 25 Nov 2026).
Port 22 on cats2 closes only when rebuild-from-image without login and the Azure serial console are proven (Tom Dyer agreed, 25 Nov 2026).
Image = stock Ubuntu minimal + first-boot script installing kits built in the Ubuntu 22.04 build container (Tom Dyer agreed, 25 Nov 2026).
Controllers advertise capacity; a cluster arbitrator main/spare pair decides; no bidding without a decider (Tom Dyer agreed, 25 Nov 2026).
The boot is the test: every restart ends with cats2 on the grid with nobody logging in (hitlist by Claude (Fable 5.2), agreed by Tom Dyer).
Recover cats2 by rebuild, not repair; offline suites are regression only (agreed by Tom Dyer, 25 Nov 2026).
Every update states architecture Tom Dyer, who coded, who wrote it, a self-score, signed by the writing model (standing rule).
